title.rendered: Healthy and Safe Schools Plan Notification

content.rendered:
Integrated Pest Management Plan – Weed Spraying Notification

In accordance with our Integrated Pest Management Plan (IPM) we are providing notice of the application of pesticides on school grounds. Weather permitting, herbicides for weed control will be used on the school grounds between Thursday, July 23rd and Friday, July 24th at 23264 SW Main Street. The area of application will be around the entire campus to maintain the landscaping. The reason for this application is to control weeds and weed removal. Details of the product that will be used are as follows. 

Product Name: Roundup Quikpro

Formulation: Soluble Concentrate Active ingredient 

EPA Registration # : 524-535

EPA Active Ingredient: Glyphosate, Diquat, Dibromide

Product Name: Specticle Flo

Formulation: Soluble Concentrate Active ingredient 

EPA Registration # : 432-1518

EPA Active Ingredient: Indaziflam

Should weather conditions force the cancellation of this application, application will be rescheduled to the first available date and time between July 27th – July 31st, 2020 when weather conditions are favorable. In the event application is postponed due to weather, warning signs will be placed 24 hours prior to the application and will remain in place for at least 72 hours after the application of these products.

It is the intention of Sherwood Charter School to comply with all federal and state regulations regarding pesticide use and to take whatever steps are necessary to ensure students, parents and employees a healthy and safe environment in which to learn and work.

For all inquiries regarding the Integrated Pest Management Plan and pesticide-related issues in our school, please contact Cheryl McLeod or Lydia Graeber, designated IPM Co-Coordinators, at (503) 925-8007

Thank you for your attention to this important issue.
